stages.title: VICIOUS CYCLE

pills.text: VICIOUS CYCLE
INCOME AND ASSET DEPRIVATION RESTRICTS THE HOUSEHOLD FOOD BASKET
FOOD INSECURITY
CALORIE DEFICIT PLUS PROTEIN AND MICRONUTRIENT DEFICIT
IMPAIRED DEVELOPMENT
COGNITIVE, PHYSICAL AND IMMUNE CAPACITY FALL
LOW HUMAN CAPITAL
SCHOOLING ATTAINMENT AND PRODUCTIVITY FALL

FOOD INSECURITY: calorie deficit plus protein and micronutrient deficit

LOW EARNINGS: the deprivation is transmitted to the next generation
